title: Of Cogs and Clockwork
description: Create Airships, Submarines, Tanks, planes, and so much more, featuring Create Aeronautics!
body:
The Modpack Froltz and friends use for their server!

This is a lightweight modpack, made to be smaller than most mainstream scaled modpacks, and focuses mostly on Create! The most primary and Noteworthy mods on the list are;

[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)

[Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics)

[Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons)

[Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)

[Sophisticated Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage)

[Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)

There are three main purposes of the mods in this pack; Creating factories and automation to make building creatively easier. Building Airships and Physics based objects for aestetic and exploration. And Ease of Acces, Quality of life, and performance enhancement mods to make the game run smoother and easier!

As a note, if you run into performance issues, start by disabling Distant Horizon's chunk rendering in it's settings! As pretty as it is, it's often the culprit of the most frame drops.
